description: Pause-menu confirmation dialogs and the Default Settings dialog. SPEC_GUI_ART sections 2.4 and 6. Static facts; "context" values are synthetic selectors.

cases.name: quit_career
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_other_single
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_racing_substate4
cases.context: game state RACING and sub-state 4 (meaning unknown), mode not 8/0x200
cases.message_english: Quit to Main Menu?^All unsaved race progress will be lost.
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_online_a
cases.context: mode 8, online-session test false, flag false
cases.message_english: Are you sure you want to quit to the Online Main Menu?
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_online_a_flag
cases.context: mode 8, online-session test false, flag true
cases.message_english: Are you sure you want to quit to the Online Main Menu?  You will receive a loss and a disconnect for this game.
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_online_b
cases.context: mode 8, online-session test true, flag false
cases.message_english: Leaving the race now will end this session.  Are you sure you want to leave?
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_online_b_flag
cases.context: mode 8, online-session test true, flag true
cases.message_english: Leaving the race now will end this session and you will be given a loss and a disconnect.  Are you sure you want to leave?
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_lan
cases.message_english: Are you sure you want to quit to the LAN main menu?
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: quit_lan_session
cases.message_english: Leaving the race now will end this session.  Are you sure you want to leave?
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: restart
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: restart_substate4
cases.message_english: Restart race?^All unsaved race progress will be lost.
cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change

cases.name: explore_substate4

cases.on_cancel: dialog closes; pause menu un-dims (UNDIM) and accepts input again; no state change
